info.title: HMD WA Gateway API
info.description: Public consumer API for the HMD WhatsApp messaging gateway. Send outbound WhatsApp messages, inspect delivery status, manage reactions and presence, and receive lifecycle events over signed webhooks.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Discover WhatsApp group JIDs the session belongs to.

get.description: Returns a minimal liveness payload. Does not touch Mongo or Redis and never leaks internals. This is the only public endpoint that requires no authentication.

post.description: Enqueue an outbound WhatsApp message to a single recipient. By default the gateway accepts, persists, and dispatches the message asynchronously (202, status `queued`). Supply `sendAt` to schedule it (202, status `scheduled`), or `confirm: true` to wait synchronously for a terminal status (200). A replay of a previously used `idempotencyKey` returns the original result with `idempotent: true` (200). The required scope is derived from `channel`: `send:notification`, `send:transactional` (default), or `send:internal`. For `image` and `document` bodies, the gateway resolves and host-validates the media `url` before dispatch (HTTPS required; loopback, link-local, private, CGNAT, and metadata addresses rejected) and returns `400 INVALID_CONTENT` on failure; this is resolve-time host validation only, not a fetch or content scan of the media itself.

200.description: Synchronous confirm result, or idempotent replay of a prior request.

202.description: Message accepted and queued, or scheduled for a future time.

get.description: List messages sent by the calling API key, newest first. Page backwards by passing the `messageId` of the last item in a page as the `before` query parameter; a page with fewer than `limit` items is the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Values above the maximum are clamped to 200.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Page backwards: pass the messageId of the last item from the previous page to fetch older messages.

get.description: Fetch the detailed status of a single message, including its chronological status history. Returns 404 if the message does not exist or does not belong to the calling API key.

post.description: Set an emoji reaction on a prior outbound message in this session. Fire-and-forget: the gateway acknowledges the queued operation (202). Requires the `send:transactional` scope. The target message must belong to this session and must already have been sent. To clear a reaction, use the DELETE method instead.

delete.description: Clear the reaction this session set on a message by sending an empty emoji. Fire-and-forget: the gateway acknowledges the queued operation (202). Requires the `send:transactional` scope. The target message must belong to this session and must already have been sent.

get.description: Discover the WhatsApp group JIDs the calling API key's bound session belongs to, so one can be passed as `to` on `POST /v1/messages`. Requires the `read:groups` scope. Results are derived from persisted chat events, so a group only appears once the session has seen at least one message in it (live or history-synced). Entries may also carry group metadata (subject, participants, admin roles and more) when the gateway has captured it; all metadata fields are optional and additive. Privacy note: `participants` exposes every member's JID and admin role to any key holding `read:groups`.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The session identifier. Must match the session the calling API key is bound to.

post.description: Push a presence indicator (typing, recording, online or offline) for this session. Best-effort at the WhatsApp layer: if the session is briefly disconnected the update is dropped. Requires the `send:transactional` scope and the API key must be bound to the session named in the path. When `to` is set, the indicator is scoped to that chat only.

get.description: Report the health of the worker and session bound to the calling API key. Requires the `read:status` scope. A session whose heartbeat is older than 60 seconds is reported as `offline`.

post.description: Sent when a message is accepted and queued for dispatch.
Sent when the worker confirms the message left the device.
Sent when WhatsApp reports the message delivered to the recipient's device.
Sent when the recipient reads the message (subject to their read-receipt settings).
Sent when a message fails to send or expires before dispatch.
Sent when the session receives an inbound message from a contact.
Sent when a contact reacts to a message in the chat. An empty `emoji` means the reaction was cleared.
Sent when a contact opts out via keyword (e.g. STOP) or is added to the opt-out registry by an admin. The session rejects future sends to this number with 422 OPTED_OUT.
Synthetic heartbeat fired on demand to verify a webhook endpoint. Treat as a no-op.

bearerAuth.description: API key supplied as a bearer token, e.g. `Authorization: Bearer hmd_sk_<division>_<env>_<secret>`.

MessageId.name: id
MessageId.description: Gateway message UUID returned by POST /v1/messages.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Optional idempotency key. The pair (API key, idempotency-key) is unique. A replay returns the original result with `idempotent: true`. May also be supplied in the request body as `idempotencyKey`.

WebhookSignatureHeader.name: X-HMD-Signature
WebhookSignatureHeader.description: Signature of the raw request body in the form `t=<unix-seconds>,v1=<hex-sha256>`, where `v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "${t}.${rawBody}")`. Reject the delivery if the timestamp is outside a 300-second window, then recompute and compare the HMAC in constant time over the raw, unmodified body bytes.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request: invalid JSON, schema violation, missing `purpose`, or an unnormalisable phone number.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, revoked, or unrecognised bearer token (UNAUTHORIZED).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but forbidden: scope missing, session mismatch, or source IP not allowed (SCOPE_DENIED, IP_NOT_ALLOWED).

NotFound.description: Referenced resource not found: message or reply target (RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_BODY).

Conflict.description: Reserved (IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT): defined for a future body-mismatch check but not currently emitted by POST /v1/messages, which returns the original result on any idempotency-key replay regardless of body.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Content-Type was not application/json. Note: UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE is defined in the protocol but the content-type guard is not currently active.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Business-logic constraint violated: opted-out recipient, scheduling window, reaction or presence validity, or incompatible field combinations (OPTED_OUT, SEND_AT_PAST, INVALID_REACTION, INVALID_PRESENCE_STATE, INVALID_BODY).

RateLimited.description: A rate-limit tier was exceeded or the per-recipient cap was reached (5 sends per 10 min, global across keys). Code: RATE_LIMITED. VELOCITY_EXCEEDED and NEW_RECIPIENT_BLOCKED are protocol-defined but not currently emitted.

InternalError.description: Unhandled server error. Quote the requestId when reporting (INTERNAL).

ServiceUnavailable.description: The bound session (or, for pooled keys, no pooled session) is offline, mid-pairing, or stopped (WORKER_UNAVAILABLE). MAINTENANCE is protocol-defined but not currently emitted.

MessagePurpose.description: Caller-declared intent of the message; drives compliance routing, retention, and audit. Required on send, no default.

MessageChannel.description: Message classification; drives the scope check and worker throttle category.

ImageBody.description: An image message fetched from a publicly reachable URL.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the image. Subject to an SSRF check at send time.

DocumentBody.description: A document message fetched from a publicly reachable URL.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the document. Subject to an SSRF check at send time.

ReplyTo.description: Quote a prior outbound message. Cannot be combined with `sendAt`.

messageId.description: Gateway UUID of a prior outbound message in the same session.

to.description: Recipient. Either a phone number, or a WhatsApp group JID for a standalone group send. Phone: E.164 is canonical (+447700900123); the gateway also normalises numbers with spaces, dashes or parentheses, and unnormalisable input returns 400 INVALID_PHONE. Group: pass the group JID (120363XXXXXXXXXXXX@g.us); the gateway validates its shape and dispatches through the same path as a DM. Group caveats: replyTo is rejected with 422 (group quoting is not yet supported), and the opt-out registry does not apply (a group send is never blocked by OPTED_OUT).

channel.description: Message classification; selects the required send scope. Defaults to `transactional`.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key, 8 to 128 characters. A replay returns the original result with `idempotent: true`.

ttlSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before dropping the message if still queued. 30 to 86400 (24 hours); defaults to 1800 (30 minutes). After expiry the message transitions to `expired`.

sendAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime to schedule the send. Must be at least 30 seconds and at most 30 days in the future. Cannot be combined with `confirm` or `replyTo`.

confirm.description: Opt into synchronous confirm: wait for a terminal status before responding (200 rather than 202). Cannot be combined with `sendAt`.

confirmTimeoutMs.description: Confirm-mode wait window in milliseconds, 300 to 30000. Used only when `confirm` is true. On timeout the response status is `queued`.

status.description: Resulting status. Async sends return `queued` or `scheduled`; confirm sends return `sent`, `failed`, or `queued` on timeout.

scheduledFor.description: Present on scheduled sends: the dispatch time.

idempotent.description: True when an idempotency key replayed a prior message.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable failure code; present only when status is `failed`.

requestId.description: Mirrors the X-Request-Id response header. Present on confirm and idempotent-replay bodies.

body.description: Body summary; only `kind` is exposed in the list view.

messages.description: A page of message summaries, newest first. There is no cursor field; to page backwards pass the messageId of the last item as the `before` query parameter. A page with fewer than `limit` items is the last page.

ttlExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time after which an unsent message is dropped.

errorCode.description: Failure code; present only when status is `failed`.

body.description: Body summary; only `kind` is exposed in the detail view.

emoji.description: A single Unicode emoji (Extended_Pictographic), 1 to 8 characters. Use DELETE to clear a reaction; an empty emoji on POST returns 422 INVALID_REACTION.

messageId.description: UUID of the reaction operation (not the target message).

emoji.description: The emoji set, or an empty string when cleared.

PresenceState.description: Presence indicator. `available`/`unavailable` set the online state; `composing`/`recording`/`paused` reflect typing or audio activity.

to.description: Optional recipient. When set, the indicator is scoped to that chat only; unnormalisable input returns 400 INVALID_PHONE.

sessionId.description: Present when the calling API key is bound to a session.

status.description: Effective session status. Reported as `offline` when the heartbeat is older than 60 seconds.

lastHeartbeatAt.description: ISO 8601 time of the last worker heartbeat, or null.

connectedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the session connected, or null.

phoneE164.description: Paired phone number in E.164, or null.

queueDepth.description: Pending outbound queue depth, or null when unknown.

subject.description: Group subject/name, when the gateway has captured one. Not always available.

lastActivityAt.description: ISO 8601 of the most recent message the gateway observed in this group.

subjectOwner.description: JID of whoever last changed the subject, when captured.

subjectTime.description: ISO 8601 of the last subject change, when captured.

creation.description: ISO 8601 of group creation, when captured.

descId.description: Opaque id of the current description, when captured.

announce.description: Only admins may post when true.

restrict.description: Only admins may change group settings when true.

size.description: Participant count as reported by Baileys, independent of participants.length.

ephemeralDuration.description: Disappearing-messages duration in seconds; absent or 0 means off.

inviteCode.description: Current group invite code, when captured.

participants.description: Every group member's JID and admin role, when captured. Exposed to any API key holding read:groups, see the GET /v1/groups description.

metadataFetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 of when the gateway last captured this group's metadata.

jid.description: Participant's JID (their phone number, in effect).

admin.description: Admin role, or null when the participant is not an admin.

groups.description: The session's known groups. May be empty if the session has not yet been observed in any group.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Flat error body returned on every non-2xx response. Match on `code`, never on the human-readable `error` string.

error.description: Human-readable error message; may change without notice.

code.description: Machine-readable, stable error code. All values are valid contract codes; those marked reserved in the API reference (MAINTENANCE, NEW_RECIPIENT_BLOCKED, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, VELOCITY_EXCEEDED, WEBAUTHN_REQUIRED) are defined but not currently emitted by any route. INVALID_CONTENT is emitted by `POST /v1/messages` when an `image` or `document` `url` fails host validation.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier; mirrors the X-Request-Id header.

at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the event was emitted.

eventId.description: UUID v4, stable across retries for idempotent processing.

messageId.description: Gateway UUID, set when the reacted-to message was authored by us.

waMessageId.description: Raw WhatsApp id of the reacted-to message.

targetFromMe.description: Whether we authored the original message.

emoji.description: The reaction emoji; empty string when cleared.

keyword.description: The exact keyword that triggered the opt-out; present only when source is `keyword`.

message.const: This is a test webhook from HMD WA Gateway.
